source_excerpts.text:
## 1. New precise problem

The prior role/address mapping assumes an address is already present to direct the corresponding worker. A descendant starting with one intact founder and fresh feed has no inherited exterior material. Which founder-produced pioneer roles must be synthesized before role-mediated address recruitment can become self-sustaining? When can a provisional physical pioneer be withdrawn, and when can its corresponding **genetic instruction** be deleted?

Let V={0,...,K-1} denote role/address capabilities and let each role j have a family of alternative prerequisite sets P_j: any one all-available set is sufficient to generate j. A founding genotype can produce initially active roles S, possibly by manufacturing genetically encoded temporary extracellular seed structures. The dynamics is monotone during one startup episode: A_0=S and A_{t+1}=A_t ∪ {j: exists P in P_j with P ⊆ A_t}. Once formed, all roles are retained during this idealized closure test. This assumption is explicitly relaxed in the seed-loss race below.

### Bootstrap obstruction theorem

Call U⊆V nonempty **self-blocking** if, for every j in U, every allowed prerequisite P ∈ P_j has P∩U ≠ ∅. This includes the case in which role j has no allowed production rule. Then:

**Closure(S)=V if and only if S hits every self-blocking U.** It suffices to hit every inclusion-minimal such U.

Proof: If U is self-blocking and U∩S=∅, by induction no role in U can ever be made because creating the first role in U always requires a role in U already. Conversely, if Closure(S)≠V, let U=V\Closure(S). For each j∈U, no prerequisite set P can be contained in Closure(S), so every allowed P intersects U. This makes U a self-blocking set disjoint from S. QED.

This is closely related to standard bootstrap-percolation / target-set selection stopping-set reasoning. The theorem's distinctive role here is to certify a *source-closed developmental genotype*, not a new combinatorics result.

### Two exact 12-role constructions

A 12-role directed unary cycle has one minimal blocker (all 12 nodes), minimum pioneer set size one, and 12 choices of that seed. Four independent three-role clusters in which every role requires **both** partners have 12 inclusion-minimal two-role blockers (three per cluster), minimum pioneer seed size eight, and 3^4=81 minimum pioneer sets. FRESH-ORIGIN AND/OR BOOTSTRAP CERTIFICATES
For a finite monotone family of OR-of-AND prerequisite sets, a nonemptyU is self-blocking when every production option for everyj inU intersectsU. If initialS missesU, induction forbids the first member ofU. Conversely, an incomplete fixed-point closure leavesU=V\closure(S), and every production option forj inU intersectsU. Thus full closure iffS hits all self-blockingU; hitting their inclusion-minimal members suffices. An empty allowed prerequisite creates a spontaneous role and prevents a blocker containing it; no production rule at all makes a role require a seed. Strongly connected ordinary dependency graphs lose AND information and cannot replace this certificate.
A unary12-cycle has minimum pioneer size1 and12 such seeds; four disjoint AND triads have minimum8,81 seed sets and12 minimal blockers. Exact finite enumeration has exponential2^K cost, not an efficient general seed optimizer. Independent uniform spontaneous seeding gives a reliability polynomialR(p)=N_m p^m+O(p^(m+1)); the log slope tends tom, but finitep biases it and rare complete outcomes impose actual sample cost. The four-triad expression(3p^2-2p^3)^4 gives slope8-8p/(3-2p); lowp estimation does not identify roles or cheaply acquire their causality. Correlated/nonuniform seed events or changed downstream/reporting laws invalidate this assay.
The receipt policy has per-attempt correct acceptancea=p*beta^h and false acceptanceb=(1-p)*alpha^h. WithK distinct needed roles and budgetN, success=Pr[Bin(N,a+b)>=K]*(a/(a+b))^K. It requires address-specific receipts, discardable failed attempts, independent readings/attempts and no later rescue of false-accepted roles. A systematic all-positive state defeats repeated readings. Count every attempt, binary reading, rejected object and cap/episode. A synthetic cheaper-feedback crossover is not a measured sensor advantage.
Two expiring pioneers competing with maturationgamma give gamma/(gamma+2lambda) only under fatal expiry/no replacement. Repeating the same independent lifecycle makes a severe penalty; it is not a general biological ratio requirement. Physical seed withdrawal and deletion of its inherited manufacturing instruction are different operations: the completed AND triad can survive material withdrawal while a fresh descendant with only one basal capability cannot start. Retain the source programme
